rubric.pairClean: Claims, truth and evidence agree and every policy threshold is met with margin: approve.
rubric.pairFraud: The claims alone would pass, but one verified fact contradicts them: refer for verification (review), not approve.
rubric.pairConcealmentVerified: Verified debt from the bureau takes DTI past the 45% cap: decline on verified figures.
rubric.fico: Claimed FICO below 660 declines; 660 and above passes.
rubric.dti: DTI above 45% declines; from 36% to 45% goes to review; below 36% passes.
rubric.liquidity: At DTI above 40%, checking under $1,000 adds a liquidity flag; the elevated DTI already means review.
rubric.conflictMaterial: Income overstated and debt understated, each above its HIGH threshold: refer for verification.
rubric.conflictSubThreshold: Income overstated and debt understated, each below its HIGH threshold: together the claims cannot be relied on, so re-underwrite on verified figures (review).
rubric.thin: A missing document the decision depends on → review; one it does not depend on is noted and the case is decided on the remaining evidence.
